messages:
infra-oncall-bot: ALERT: eu-west1-gpu-pool degraded — ~40% nodes NotReady, prometheus scrape failures, autoscaler paused. incident id: INC-1795.
anna: seeing 503s from model-serving in eu-west1, traffic auto-shifted to us-west, latency spike for customers.
mike: confirmed. kubectl shows nodes NotReady + CNI flaps. kubelet logs show repeated network disconnects.
sara: grafana: prometheus remote_write backlog increased, many scrape targets in eu-west1 show 'no_data' since 09:12. looks like metrics silence, not just spikes.
dinesh: telemetry -> fluentd/log-shipper shows backpressure and dropped batches. we deployed log-shipper 2.1.3 at 08:59 in eu-west1 earlier today.
remy: can we roll back the shipper? that would reduce backpressure and let exporters come up.
mike: rolling rollback now: `kubectl -n kube-logging rollout undo daemonset/log-shipper`
infra-oncall-bot: rollout undo triggered by mike. status: 2/3 updated pods terminating.
anna: prometheus scrape targets still failing for node-exporter and gpu-exporter, getting 503s on /metrics.
sara: pulled logs from one exporter pod — `curl localhost:9100/metrics` -> 503. exporter log: "failed to open device /dev/nvidia0: resource busy" and repeated retries. looks like exporter sidecar not getting resources due to node-level egress flood from shipper backlog.
dinesh: quick mitigation: scale exporter replicas to spread load and bypass local bottleneck: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy gpu-exporter --replicas=3` (eu-west1 only).
remy: scaled to 3. new pods creating.
sara: metrics are trickling back. prometheus remote_write backlog decreasing, backfill started for ~5m gap. traces still partial — jaeger agent didn't forward spans during the peak.
mike: temporary workaround: point eu-west1 prometheus remote_write to us-west remote instance to flush backlog (expect egress costs). patched secret `prom-remote-url` to us-west endpoint.
anna: customer comms: posted status in #customer-notify — routing to us-west and working on metric recovery.
dinesh: immediate follow-ups (created INFRA-5723):
- revert problematic log-shipper release in eu clusters and pin to 2.1.2
- add exporter startup readiness check that fails fast if device resources unavailable
- add prometheus alert for scrape_group: node-exporter/for:5m -> fire when group has >50% targets down
- add metric for remote_write queue_length and exporter restart rate
- add post-deploy smoke test that validates /metrics on a sample of pods
remy: changed log-shipper config to reduce buffer pressure: `flush_interval: 5s`, `max_buffer_size: 50MB` and re-deployed to eu-west1.
sara: verification: prometheus has resumed scrapes for node-exporter/gpu-exporter and most dashboards are green. backfill complete for 09:12-09:20 window.
mike: note — autoscaler was paused by controller due to scrape silence; we resumed autoscaler after metrics recovered.
anna: postmortem items: missing alert for prometheus scrape silence on exporter groups and no cross-region remote_write fallback. add playbook step to route metrics when regional ingestion degrades.
remy: adding to postmortem: reproduction test for log-shipper backpressure with simulated high-throughput logs.
infra-oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: capacity recovered and metrics ingestion restored at 09:28. root cause: regression in log-shipper release causing backpressure -> blocked exporter init -> prometheus scrape silence. Follow-ups logged in INFRA-5723 and postmortem draft started.
